coaching_overview: This 4-week Base Building block establishes aerobic foundation and introduces quality stimulus. Athlete shows recent low volume (5 km runs). Block progressively builds from 28 km (Week 1) to 34.5 km peak (Week 3), then tapers to 26 km recovery (Week 4). Two quality sessions per week (tempo + intervals/strides) follow polarized model: ~80% easy aerobic work, ~20% hard. Training paces anchored to recent Strava fitness: easy/long run at 6:14/km, tempo at 5:29/km, intervals at ~5:00/km (estimated VO2 max). No consecutive hard days. Long run progresses conservatively (8 → 10 → 12 → 9.5 km). Week 4 reduces volume 20-25% for adaptation. Next block (Weeks 5–8) enters Aerobic Development: introduces marathon pace segments in long runs, extends tempo and interval work, and builds cumulative fitness toward peak training.
